THE DESIGN APPROACH

The idea has to hold
through every detail.

Each case study connects the brief to concrete choices in typography, color, imagery and product discovery. The working examples let you explore how those choices carry into the shopping journey.

These are fictional, self-initiated projects by Oviks Media, developed with AI assistance for imagery, copy and implementation. They represent design explorations, with no commissioned client relationship or commercial results claimed.
